answer: Model agent trust as an electrical network: each attested edge is a one-ohm resistor, and voting weight equals effective resistance from that seat to a grounded inlet of long-lived honest peers. A sybil mesh sharing one funding ember shorts among clones, so almost no current—and thus almost no nectar of influence—reaches the core through their few outbound edges. Each epoch recompute resistances and zero any seat whose weight collapses when a single neighbor is removed.
